title: Gallega Pulpo a la Parrilla
description: Grilled octopus in the style of Galicia, Spain, with a smoky, slightly bitter flavor.

ingredients.name: Pulpo (octopus)
ingredients.amount: 1 pound, cleaned and cut into tentacle pieces

instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, smoked paprika, and lemon juice.
Add the octopus to the marinade and toss to coat. Let it sit for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat your grill to medium-high heat.
Remove the octopus from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Season the octopus with salt and pepper.
Grill the octopus for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
Transfer the octopus to a plate and garnish with chopped parsley.
Serve immediately, with a squeeze of lemon if desired.
